$description: Primitives: palette, alpha colours, font, space, radius, stroke, shadow, blur, opacity, z-index, duration, easing, breakpoints, aspect ratios.

com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

palette.$description: Raw palette. Every distinct opaque colour the system uses. Consume semantic tokens (color.bg, color.text, color.fill) in product code; palette tokens are for building those and for print specification.

cream.$description: Paper-cream page ground (light canvas) and the light ink on dark fills.

cream-dark.$description: Card and use-case ground on cream.

paper.$description: Surface for inputs, code blocks and menus in light mode.

white.$description: Raised surface (menus) in light mode; dark-mode hover for the cream accent.

black.$description: Pressed state of the ink accent; shadow base.

ink.$description: Near-black ink: primary text, the accent fill, focus ring and strong borders in light mode.

graphite.$description: Secondary text and the accent hover fill in light mode.

pebble.$description: Faint text in light mode. Decorative and disabled content only (2.5:1 on cream).

cream-inset.$description: Inset areas and photo placeholders in light mode.

sage.$description: Fill theme: sage. Default section theme; table highlight accent and marker ink.

teal.$description: Fill theme: teal. Also the light-mode text selection ground and the dark-mode accent pressed fill.

forest.$description: Fill theme: forest. Dark-mode canvas and the dark surface context.

clay-red.$description: Fill theme: clay red. Cream text only.

dark-teal.$description: Fill theme: dark teal. Cream text only.

dark-grey.$description: Fill theme: dark grey. Cream text only.

signal-green.$description: Success signal fill (dots, icons, soft tints). Not for small text: 4.06:1 on cream.

signal-amber.$description: Warning signal fill. Not for small text: 3.77:1 on cream.

signal-red.$description: Danger signal fill and light-mode danger text (5.24:1 on cream).

signal-cyan.$description: Info signal fill. Not for small text: 3.87:1 on cream.

moss-grey.$description: Dark-mode faint text; decorative and disabled content only (3.75:1 on forest).

ink-72-cream.$description: Muted-strong text on light grounds: 72% ink over cream (site.css --muted-text). 7.52:1 on cream.

cream-72-forest.$description: Muted-strong text on dark grounds: 72% cream over forest (--muted-text resolved in dark mode). 8.85:1 on forest.

signal-green-deep.$description: Success text on light grounds. Signal green darkened in OKLab to 4.6:1 minimum on every light ground and on its 16% tint.

signal-amber-deep.$description: Warning text on light grounds (OKLab-darkened signal amber, 4.6:1 minimum).

signal-red-deep.$description: Danger text on light grounds (OKLab-darkened signal red, 4.6:1 minimum on grounds and tint).

signal-cyan-deep.$description: Info text on light grounds (OKLab-darkened signal cyan, 4.6:1 minimum).

signal-green-light.$description: Success text on dark grounds (OKLab-lightened, 4.6:1 minimum on forest grounds).

signal-amber-light.$description: Warning text on dark grounds (OKLab-lightened, 4.6:1 minimum).

signal-red-light.$description: Danger text on dark grounds (OKLab-lightened, 4.6:1 minimum).

signal-cyan-light.$description: Info text on dark grounds (OKLab-lightened, 4.6:1 minimum).

alpha.$description: Translucent colours. Each is a base palette colour at a fixed alpha, exactly as the source declares them (rgba(), #rrggbbaa or color-mix with transparent).

ink-5.$description: Tint wells, card kind chip ground, hover ground (light).

ink-6.$description: Shadow colour (xs, sm) and dusty-pink feature tag ground.

ink-8.$description: Terracotta feature tag ground; outline-on-fill hover ground.

ink-10.$description: Card hover ground, selected ground, subtle borders, status badge ground (light).

ink-14.$description: Playing transcript line on light fills.

ink-65.$description: Secondary text on teal and sand fills.

ink-70.$description: Secondary text on sage, warm-grey and stone fills.

cream-5.$description: Forest and dark-grey feature tag ground.

cream-8.$description: Tint wells and hover ground (dark); inverse tag ground.

cream-12.$description: Hairlines on dark fills; subtle borders (dark); clay-red feature tag ground.

cream-14.$description: Playing transcript line on dark fills.

com.desertpants.source: desertant.com brand/index.css site.css .replay-lines p.is-active color-mix(ink 14%) on dark fills

cream-20.$description: Inverse borders; hairlines on clay-red fills.

cream-35.$description: Unplayed portion of media progress on dark fills.

cream-42.$description: Control boundaries on dark grounds (3:1 on every dark ground in color.bg).

cream-55.$description: Secondary text on forest and ink fills; eyebrow on dark surface.

black-8.$description: Hover overlay on clay-red and dark-grey fills (darkens the ground so cream text keeps 4.5:1).

com.desertpants.source: desertant.com brand/index.css derived for clay-red and dark-grey overlays

black-10.$description: Feature-card border; post, pin and hero shadows; pressed overlay on clay-red and dark-grey fills.

black-14.$description: Playing transcript line on clay-red and dark-grey fills (darkens the ground).

com.desertpants.source: desertant.com brand/index.css derived for clay-red and dark-grey overlays

black-20.$description: Round control hover on clay-red and dark-grey fills (darkens the ground).

transparent.$description: Fully transparent (ink at 0%): quiet button grounds, invisible borders that keep layout stable.

font.$description: Font primitives. Families ship in /fonts (SIL OFL 1.1).

display.$description: Headings, titles, buttons, navigation, claims and inputs. Variable 300-700, roman and italic.

mono.$description: Body copy, ledes, labels, tags, eyebrows, data, tables and code. Weights 400-700.

ui.$description: Native control text only where the platform draws the control (date pickers, native selects). Never for brand copy.

arabic.$description: Arabic-script text (Arabic, Persian, Urdu and the rest): the letters Inclusive Sans and JetBrains Mono lack. A humanist sans with Inclusive Sans's open forms; variable 100-900.

hebrew.$description: Hebrew text: the letters Inclusive Sans and JetBrains Mono lack. Variable 100-900.

light.$description: Light. Reserved; no source component uses it.

regular.$description: Mono body, data, small tags and prose emphasis (strong renders regular in prose).

medium.$description: Claims, captions, eyebrows, tags, footer links and table highlight rows.

semibold.$description: All display headings, titles, buttons, navigation and stat values.

2xs.$description: Table heads, meta lines, specs, status badges and micro copy.

xs.$description: Eyebrows, tags, labels, breadcrumbs, captions of data.

base.$description: Body copy, card claims, navigation and small buttons.

lg.$description: Ledes, large buttons, labels, inputs and model names.

xl.$description: h3, card titles and media stats.

2xl.$description: Narrow stat values, docs h2, large wordmark.

5xl.$description: Large stat and about-page numerals maximum.

hero-model.$description: Line height of the fill-hero title (tight stacked display).

model.$description: Line height of the model page title.

hero.$description: Line height of display / hero headlines.

heading.$description: Feature titles and featured post titles.

snug.$description: h2-h4, buttons, navigation, card titles, labels.

normal.$description: Claims, hero sub, inputs, table heads.

relaxed.$description: Mono body copy, ledes and code.

loose.$description: Highlighted result text with inline entity marks.

display.$description: Display, h1 and hero titles. Unit: em.

tighter.$description: h2, h4, buttons, labels, stat values, wordmark. Unit: em.

tight.$description: h3, card titles, navigation, row headers. Unit: em.

snug.$description: Claims, captions, footer links, input text. Unit: em.

normal.$description: Mono body copy and notes. Unit: em.

wide.$description: Breadcrumbs, meta, segmented controls, chips. Unit: em.

wider.$description: Eyebrows, tags, table heads, labels. Unit: em.

inline-code.$description: Inline code font-size relative to surrounding text (em).

code-block.$description: Code, kbd, samp and docs inline code relative size (em).

measure.$description: Maximum line length for reading copy (46rem).

display-max.$description: When the reader enlarges text, type roles of 32px and above (and the wordmark) grow to at most this multiple of their design size, so headlines keep fitting their columns; smaller roles scale without limit. Web: the browser default font size (clamp in each role). iOS: DPTextStyle.maxScale and .dynamicTypeSize(...style.dynamicTypeCap), the largest Dynamic Type size within the cap. Android: DpTextStyle.maxScale, fontScale() and sizeDp().

support.$description: Every layout stays readable at this text-size multiplier without clipping, overlap or horizontal scrolling (WCAG 1.4.4). The specimen screenshots test it.

space.$description: Spacing scale (4px base, source rem values converted at 16px). Web output writes rem.

2.$description: Tag and button icon gaps, list gaps.

3.$description: Card internal gap, table cell block padding.

4.$description: Card-grid gap, button-row gap, code block padding.

6.$description: Card padding, compact gutter, stat-row gap.

7.$description: Reserved step between 24px and 32px; no source component uses it.

8.$description: Section gap, panel padding, compact stat padding.

10.$description: Use-case and post-body padding, site-nav gap.

12.$description: Stat block padding, model hero gap.

16.$description: Wide gaps, feature-card head top padding.

sm.$description: Inline code, copy buttons, focus-ring corners, bar feet.

lg.$description: Small buttons, inputs, tabs, nav items, menus, chart bar tops.

3xl.$description: Feature cards, panels, stats, photos, post cards, tabs container, dialogs.

pill.$description: Tags, chips, segmented controls, search fields.

full.$description: Circles and capsules (dots, avatars, progress, toggle lines).

hero-fill.$description: Bottom corners of the full-bleed fill hero (regular layout).

hero-fill-compact.$description: Bottom corners of the fill hero at compact widths.

border-width.$description: Stroke widths for borders, rings and drawn marks.

hair.$description: Hairlines, card and input borders, dividers.

thin.$description: Compact chart bars; outlined text stroke.

thick.$description: Outline buttons, stat and versus frames, chart marks, blockquote rule.

quote.$description: Accent rule of blog pull quotes.

focus.$description: Focus ring width on every interactive element.

shadow.$description: Elevation. Surfaces are flat by default; shadows are for floating layers, photos and feature cards.

lg.$description: Menus, dropdown panels, bottom sheets, dialogs, toasts.

ring-default.$description: Inset 1px ring for outline and dot tags.

ring-strong.$description: Inset 1px ring for the selected tag.

md.$description: Backdrop blur behind floating bars and sheets.

fx.$description: Maximum blur of the text blur effect.

30.$description: Heading anchor revealed on heading hover; heartbeat start.

60.$description: Hovered navigation link; grain paper; anchor on direct hover.

100.$description: Fully opaque (resting state of revealed elements).

z.$description: Stacking order. Use only these levels.

behind.$description: Decorative layers behind content (marker ink, pulse ring).

content.$description: Card content above media and gradient scrims.

overlay-local.$description: Hovered fan card; copied overlay inside a card.

nav-header.$description: Header while compact navigation is open.

duration.$description: Durations. Animation durations collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion (see motion.reduced); dwell times (how long feedback stays) do not.

fast.$description: Colour, background and border changes; carets; opacity toggles.

base.$description: Card lift, surface change, toggle lines, copied overlay, stat reveal.

reveal.$description: Rise-in reveal of page sections; progress fills.

anchor-delay.$description: Heading-anchor reveal delay while the heading is hovered (drops to 0 on direct hover; 0 under reduced motion).

settle.$description: Tilted cards settling on hover (straightening part-way, lifting and scaling up slightly).

fx-fill.$description: Outlined text fill sweep; effect ramps.

feedback-copied.$description: How long the copied confirmation stays.

feedback-active.$description: Auto-reset of an activated demo state.

stagger.$description: Staggered reveal delays for sequential items d0-d7.

0.$description: Reveal delay for the 1th staggered block.

1.$description: Reveal delay for the 2th staggered block.

2.$description: Reveal delay for the 3th staggered block.

3.$description: Reveal delay for the 4th staggered block.

4.$description: Reveal delay for the 5th staggered block.

5.$description: Reveal delay for the 6th staggered block.

6.$description: Reveal delay for the 7th staggered block.

7.$description: Reveal delay for the 8th staggered block.

standard.$description: Default for colour, surface and small movements.

in.$description: Exits and dismissals (sheets leaving, toasts fading).

settle.$description: Tilted cards settling on hover (straightening part-way, lifting and scaling up slightly).

breakpoint.$description: Canonical viewport breakpoints (max-width of the narrower layout; the wider layout starts at value + 1px). Source one-off breakpoints are normalised to these (see docs/coverage-report.md).

xs.$description: Narrow phones: single-column everything, stacked footers.

sm.$description: Phones: compact tables, single-column forms and versus, board rows collapse.

md.$description: Primary switch: compact navigation, stacked heroes, fan becomes a column.

breakpoint-height.$description: Viewport height breakpoints (max-height of the shorter layout; the taller layout starts at value + 1px).

short.$description: Short viewports: phones in landscape and split screens. Headers and app bars use their compact height, heroes drop their minimum heights and bottom sheets may use the full height.

wide-photo.$description: Full-width photos in the xl container. (1172:606)
